snippet.title: Rivage - Demo Trailer | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45348822/sale/spring2026
